title: The Holy Spirit in a believer
note: Rebuilt on 2026-11-26 from the Bible Explorer film of the same slug. New wording, same facts: each claim is in the old film's captions or its 'differ' note, whose sources are in docs/work/elite/explorer-ledger.md. Scripture is the Berean Standard Bible, checked against client/public/bible/text/ by film/tools/write-script.py.

lines: The Holy Spirit is the third person of the Trinity, fully God, who dwells in believers and gives them life with God.
He is not a force or a feeling. He is God himself, living in his people.

scripture.text: And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.

lines: The Spirit unites believers to Christ. Jesus' own picture is a vine and its branches. The branch lives because it is joined to the vine.
I am the vine and you are the branches.
Apart from him they can do nothing.

scripture.text: I am the vine and you are the branches.

lines: To be adopted means God makes people his own children, with a sure place in his family.
Paul says God sent the Spirit of his Son into their hearts, calling out to God as Father. Abba is the Aramaic word for father.

scripture.text: God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts

lines: This is the lifelong work of the Spirit, by which believers grow to be more like Jesus. Paul names nine kinds of fruit.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control.
Fruit grows slowly, and it grows because the branch is joined to the vine.

scripture.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control.

lines: The Spirit gives gifts to each believer, and they are given for the good of all: teaching, serving, encouraging, giving, leading, showing mercy.
Paul's picture is the body, where every part is needed.

scripture.text: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.

lines: Christians agree that the Holy Spirit is God, gives new life, lives in every believer, and gives gifts to build up the church.

Churches differ on whether some gifts, such as tongues, prophecy, and healing, continue as they did in Acts, and on whether the baptism of the Spirit is a distinct experience after a person first believes. This film doesn't choose between them.
Even prayer is not left to believers alone. When they don't know how to pray, the Spirit himself intercedes for them.
The Spirit helps us in our weakness.
The Spirit is not a reward for the strong. He is help for the weak.

scripture.text: the Spirit helps us in our weakness.

lines: He is God himself, living in his people.
